verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's evidence is about OLTP database branching, backups, replicas, sharding, and NVMe performance for transactional workloads — there is no mention of columnar storage, OLAP query acceleration, or any feature specifically aimed at fast large-scale analytical aggregation for dashboards. Read replicas and Metal reduce load/IOPS but are not framed as solving heavy aggregation queries at dashboard speed, and no customer report confirms this use case.
